# Units

Every unit type in the current rules. Health, attack and defence are shown as the game shows them: the data stores tenths (a warrior has health 100, shown as 10). *XP* is the experience a unit needs before it can be promoted (0 means it cannot be promoted). *Hidden* units are not offered in the train menu: they are starting units, spawns, upgrades and Nature's units. *Tribe* lists the tribes that use the unit in place of a standard one (the standard unit is in brackets).

## Units bound to certain terrain

A unit with a `movement_terrain` list may only enter those terrains, whatever the player's techs. Training such a unit needs a neighbouring tile of one of them.

| Unit | Terrain |
| --- | --- |
| `raychi` | `water`, `ocean`, `wetland` |
| `jelly` | `water`, `ocean`, `wetland` |
| `shark` | `water`, `ocean`, `wetland` |
| `aquapult` | `water`, `ocean`, `wetland` |
| `island` | `water`, `ocean`, `wetland` |

How the stats are used: [combat](../combat.md), [movement](../movement.md), [abilities](../abilities.md).
